about: Coverage is partial: this file maps 10 of the matrix's roughly 450 full-run legs (gate-prepass.py prints the live count). A changed path no entry covers is reported as coverage-unmapped, never as nothing to rerun; mappedLegs must equal the number of checks. Exact matrix invocation -> the source paths it covers and the files that implement the check. Read by scripts/gate-prepass.py (owner of this file). A change to a covered path recommends the check; listing never proves the check ran. Globs: ** spans directories, * and ? stay inside one. Every invocation must be a literal run-matrix.sh leg (args after run/run_leg/run_app_check) that the static reader does not find dead, and every glob must match a file, or the pre-pass reports the entry stale. Targeted-only declarations live in targetedOnly as {flag, reason}; reason must be one non-empty line. They declare intentional targeted checks without adding nightly coverage. Exceptions are line-specific (rule + path + exact trimmed line) and need a reason and an owner.

checks.reason: packaged resources and bundle identity are only proven in the assembled bundle (--packaged-resources-check runs there)
drives mountWorkspaceSceneAtBoot, the production scene mount
spawn placement against the target zone
every spawner installs through the zone path
flat-scene retirement never strands or drops a tile
delegation over the production workspace API
delegation across Claude, Codex and Pi harnesses
every agent, tile, tile-metadata and zone coding key is classified; the diff cannot decide classification
sender census against the maintained notification map (structural, not behavioural)
fixture histories prove every pre-pass rule red and green

targetedOnly.reason: Prints what the run ledger adds to the request path and asserts nothing about time, so it guards no bug class.
